name: TownePlace Suites Las Vegas Stadium District

sources.observed: Official exterior8519 and7441 fullsize images inspected: five storeys, arrival elevation ochre/white/charcoal with horizontal timber stair strip and steel canopy/pergola; street elevation white/charcoal vertical cladding, shallow sloped overhanging roof caps. Lobby8513 and reception8521 show pale wood floor, curved lower accessible reception, wood TV column, red dining chairs and market.
Satellite inspected: long east-west hotel south of Tropicana, arrival on south side, pool at west end. Home2 is separate southeast neighbor.

Official pool photograph visually inspected: rounded freeform basin with broad curved entry steps, blue tile waterline, stainless handrails and accessible pool lift, black vertical-bar safety fence, beige deck, gray mesh loungers, gray umbrellas, stone boundary wall, palms. Hotel west end behind pool is ochre/white with three window columns and ground stone; current white west elevation does not match.

Official market gallery modal visually inspected: integrated pale wood cabinet, upper open snack shelves, glazed upper center cabinet, twin lower refrigerator/freezer doors and full-height stainless drink refrigerator at right with five stocked shelves and vented plinth. Current single small market cabinet is undersized; replacement remains next public-room step.

uncertainDimensions: Mapped footprint fixes perimeter. Five floors visible; height estimated pending surveyed elevation. Source6m height is a generic fallback, not used as reference.
Public lobby/breakfast layout inferred from official photos, not a verified floorplan.

West pool photo8532 and satellite establish alignment west of hotel; local survey x[-890,-850],z[1725,1770] contains only owned way/431504486, no separate mapped pool structure. No neighboring geometry edited.

Pool/terrace approximately x[-875,-854],z[1736,1763], approach extends south to1765.2. Satellite building width anchors scaling; basin is an inferred rounded outline, not surveyed. Issue278 expanded to bounded west hotel terrace before edits.
implemented: Original stepped five-storey facade on mapped footprint, distinct arrival/street cladding, framed windows, roof crowns, arrival canopy and pergola.
Inferred public lobby with reception, accessible counter, market refrigerator, dining seating, TV column and breakfast counter; existing streamed interior lighting.
Targeted169 placeholder visual and corresponding collision triangles removed.
Installed inspection corrected open crown undersides and removed incorrect timber cladding from the north street elevation.
2026-10-27 follow-up: fitted north lettering within roof backing and subdued bright cladding seams; installed arrival/street/west views inspected.

Street facade central projection changed to horizontally jointed charcoal, horizontal white band restored, crown fascia thinned and dark backing added. Original procedural curtain glazing added. Source review completed; installed street/arrival/west views inspected.

West-end ochre/white facade, original curved pool basin and coping, entry treads/handrails, display pool lift, gray loungers/umbrellas, stone wall, feather-frond palms and colliding open-gate safety enclosure. Continuous paved route to hotel arrival. Source and all three installed daylight views reviewed. All 34 actual walking segments passed, including pool gate and return path.

Public-room refinement: shallow ceiling coffers, vents/recessed fixture geometry, base trim, blue lounge seating and coffee table, blue bench legs, timber column cap, business workstation/keyboard/chair and breakfast cabinet/cups. Official lobby8513 re-inspected; source lounge/workstation views reviewed. All six installed daylight public-room views inspected; all 34 actual walking segments rechecked successfully.
remaining: Street central projection, horizontal band and crown backing revised from official7441; upper glazing now has original curtain detail. Roof silhouette, bay proportions and exact typography remain approximate. Pool photo8532 confirms west end should have ochre/white panels; west ochre/white cladding now corrected. Fine horizontal seam aliasing remains at middle distance.

Public lobby/breakfast layout remains inferred, not a verified plan. Ceiling, workstation, lounge seating and trim refined; upholstery profiles, patterned rugs, wall art, detailed market goods and closer proportions remain approximate. Installed visual verification passed; room scale, furniture shapes and finish detail still fall short of the reference.

Pool and terrace built from official photo8532 and satellite alignment; dimensions estimated. Basin depth/swimming not implemented (existing ground below water preserved); pool lift is fixed display geometry. Planting, fuller palm crowns, furniture and waterline tile details need refinement. Installed walking/visual verification passed. Water looks excessively glossy at low angles; the shared water shader was not changed in this building pass.
Performance variance unresolved: final arrival18.2msmedian37.6p95 and breakfast19.4/33.9; street/west/lobby/reception about16.7median. Profile before claiming locked60fps.

verification.visualReview: Actual installed arrival, street, west, close entrance, lobby, reception and breakfast views inspected. Roof gaps closed, street timber corrected, sign contrast improved, accessible counter capped and wood grain toned down. Rooms remain sparsely furnished and facade/site still approximate. Follow-up street facade bands, charcoal central projection, thinner fascia and original curtain glazing inspected in source render and all3installed exterior views. Fine horizontal seam aliasing and approximate roof profiles remain; west end incorrect white cladding confirmed against officialpoolphoto. West cladding corrected; installed pool, overview and matching west views inspected. No visible paving overlap; safety gate accessible. Palm crowns sparse and pool water excessively glossy, recorded for refinement. Six installed public-detail views inspected: ceiling/vent geometry, base trim, blue lounge seats, workstation and breakfast details visible; no observed overlaps. Still sparse and stylized relative to official photo; no photorealism claim.
